verdicts.originalText: The shield only forms when the opening Detect strike lands on an enemy; a whiffed cast creates no shield.
verdicts.proposedText: Shown on every cast, but the shield only forms when the opening Detect strike lands on an enemy; a whiffed cast creates no shield.
verdicts.rationale: Legitimate optimistic-render divergence: the shield is authored as an onCast/skill effect, so the timeline draws a shield window on every skill cast, while in game it forms only when the opening Detect hitbox hits an enemy (description: 'If it hits an enemy... generating a Shield'; curator note: 'Shield generates only on the Detect hit'). Not implementDelete — the on-hit conditionality is not wired; the shield renders unconditionally by convention (cf. Diona shield-on-hit). The original states only the game rule and never frames what the tool shows, leaving mild ambiguity about whether the timeline handles it; prepending 'Shown on every cast, but' resolves that per the Voice/shown-in-game rules while preserving both original clauses. 'Detect strike' is a kit mechanic, not the ability name, so it is allowed.
